_comment: Endpoints for claude-superset-api (oci-apps, WG-only). Source of truth: cloud build.json ports (ip 10.0.0.6). Reachable from this host over the WireGuard mesh.
_sessions_comment: Cross-device session sync via the hub's /sessions store (on ep.api). device = this host's id (default: hostname); sync_keep = how many recent local sessions to push.
_local_comment: `claude-superset local` runs the same container on THIS host via docker compose (on-demand). Listeners are published to 127.0.0.1 only (never the public NIC). Image is the multi-arch binaries tag (amd64 variant pulled here). First run needs a one-time login: `docker exec -it claude-superset-api-local claude`.
